name: Tomb Guardian
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The guardian is immune to any
spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The guardian has advantage on
saving throws against spell and other magical
effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text:
The guardian's weapon attacks are
magical.

traits.name: Bound Regeneration
traits.text:
The guardian is bound to an
item or set of items within the tomb it guards. At
the beginning of the guardian's turn, it regains 10
hit points as long as that item is not destroyed. This
regeneration continues even after the guardian is
reduced to 0 hit points and it can only be
permanently killed when this item (or these items)
have been removed.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft.,
one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Debris Toss
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit,
range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5)
bludgeoning damage.
